'''Ringtail''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Rizzler]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Ringtail is an expert at finding things without owners somehow. Cookies left on the bakery counter, fresh fruit from the market... and since everything's shared among four, Ringtail always makes a point to grab a couple extra."

Ringtail is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, brown raccoon with a blue cloth tied above its shoulders. It stands bipedal and has off-white and orange accents in its fur.

Ringtail's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of its cloth to green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Ringtail's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Rizzler]] you need to complete the following task:

* Obtain a total of 50 of the following foods: Cookies, Rock Sugar Rings, Gem Tacos, or Stone Cakes (any combination).

== Trivia ==
* Ringtail and its evolutions were added to the game on 9/8/2026 alongside [[Blechlama]] and [[Morphanessa]].
